description: T77W968 as Telit LN960, MBIM: not in the kernel table; cdc_mbim takes the class-compliant data channel, the vendor (ff) serial ports need option new_id with class ff (another modem manager usbports); driven under ModemManager

bind.source: another modem manager usbports.sh: option1 new_id '<vid> <pid> ff' (the class keeps cdc_mbim's data interface); every vendor interface but ADB; the working notes

hints.at_source: a router vendor's port map for 1bc7:1910/1911: AT ttyUSB2, SMS ttyUSB1; option on 02-04 = ttyUSB0..2. Not seen on our bench yet; ModemManager ignores this modem's ttys (mm_ports control)
